propositions: The bugfix-size attestation gate blocks any large bug fix (>150 non-test lines) whose plan-review attestation is signed by an unpinned developer environment, because the not-pinned arm of classify_plan_review_attestation returns mismatch verdict which prevents acceptance.

An attested plan review that passes locally in a developer environment cannot clear the gate without an attestation from the pinned prod op-cert environment, for which no client exists in the repo and no mechanism to record and persist the returned envelope.

The gate gates on the source of certification (which environment signed) rather than on the fact of a completed, signed plan review, making the criterion unsatisfiable for contributors whose environments are not pinned in trusted_environments.yaml.

The attestation check must be refactored to gate only on the fact of a valid, lifecycle-sound plan-review attestation with correct subject binding (ticket id and kind), removing the trusted_env_keyring lookup and verify_opcert provenance verification.

Subject binding must be re-asserted as an explicit step after deleting verify_opcert, since that was its only enforcement site, to prevent replayed attestations from different tickets or kinds from being accepted.
